value: stellate versus disc-shaped neuron (dendritic length-to-width criterion)
quote: Oliver and colleagues distinguished disc-shaped from stellate neurons by calculating the length to width ratio of the dendritic arbor

Oliver and colleagues distinguished disc-shaped from stellate neurons by calculating the length to width ratio of the dendritic arbor: neurons with a ratio <3 were stellate and those with a ratio >= 3 were disc-shaped ( Oliver et al., 1991 ). Applying this classification to our sample, 93% of VIP neurons in the ICc (39 of 42 neurons) had a length to width ratio <3, therefore being classified as stellate ( Figure 5H ). Only three VIP neurons from the ICc had a length to width ratio >3.
